title: Photorealistic cinematic vertical beauty
prompt:
Photorealistic cinematic vertical beauty and lifestyle portrait of a young adult woman in her early twenties, approximately 20 years old, with an East Asian appearance, posing indoors in a softly illuminated modern apartment. Captured from a slightly elevated, intimate high-angle perspective, the composition frames her from the top of her head to her upper hips, emphasizing her elegant facial features, flowing hair, relaxed posture, and naturally feminine silhouette.

She has a delicate oval-to-heart-shaped face, softly rounded cheeks, a refined V-shaped jawline, a petite pointed chin, a small straight nose with a gently defined bridge, and naturally full, softly pink lips. Her large, expressive dark brown almond-shaped eyes feature subtle smoky eyeliner, long delicately separated eyelashes, softly blended neutral eyeshadow, and luminous catchlights. Her eyebrows are naturally arched and meticulously groomed. She gazes thoughtfully downward and toward the left side of the frame with a calm, slightly dreamy, subtly contemplative expression. Two small, natural beauty marks are visible near her cheek and lower jawline.

Her exceptionally long, thick, silky dark chocolate-brown hair cascades over her left shoulder and down across her chest, with gentle waves, soft volume, a side part, and fine strands framing her face. Her right-side hair is loosely swept back behind her ear, revealing a small silver hoop earring. She wears a delicate, thin silver necklace with a petite floral-shaped pendant resting just above her collarbones.

She has a slender yet naturally curvaceous figure, a defined waist, a full bust with realistic proportions, graceful shoulders, and smooth, fair skin with warm ivory undertones. Her left arm is raised and bent behind her head, with her elbow extending toward the left edge of the composition, creating a relaxed, asymmetrical pose. Her torso angles slightly toward the camera while her head turns gently downward.

She wears a fitted mustard-yellow, finely ribbed knit camisole crop top with thin spaghetti straps, a low rounded scoop neckline, and a closely contoured silhouette. The top ends above her waist, revealing a narrow section of her midriff. She pairs it with low-rise, faded charcoal-gray denim jeans featuring visible belt loops, textured seams, and a partially visible waistband. Preserve the exact casual styling without adding extra layers or garments.

Soft natural daylight enters from the front-left, illuminating her face, collarbones, arms, and clothing with gentle highlights and realistic shadow transitions. The softly blurred background features warm cream-colored walls, a light beige floor, a partially open doorway, and understated modern interior furnishings. Simulate a premium full-frame camera with a 35mm portrait lens, f/2.0 aperture, shallow depth of field, lifelike skin microtexture, delicate hair detail, realistic fabric ribbing, subtle film grain, soft highlight roll-off, warm neutral cinematic color grading, and sophisticated editorial photography aesthetics. Ultra-detailed, natural anatomy, realistic perspective, high dynamic range, 8K photographic quality, vertical composition, aspect ratio 9:16.
